name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized kitchen contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized kitchen contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor manages various types of construction projects, while a specialized kitchen contractor focuses exclusively on kitchen renovations. A specialized contractor often possesses deeper expertise in kitchen design, materials, and the unique challenges of kitchen projects. They may also have established relationships with kitchen-specific suppliers and subcontractors, potentially leading to a more efficient and tailored remodel. Cali View Builders brings specialized expertise to your kitchen renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor handles various projects, while a specialized kitchen contractor focuses only on kitchens, offering deeper expertise in design, materials, and unique challenges.
